svg.title: A sensor event fires an automation
svg.desc: 1. The worker keeps one WebSocket to Tuya per active home and receives a device property change. 2. Messages for the same device are processed in order and merged into the mirror with a jsonb merge. 3. Rules are checked on the edge from false to true, inside their time window and after their cooldown. 4. Actions run (device command, scene, notification or camera photo) and each is logged with the source automation.
